introduction: No theme, on purpose. A rice dish sits next to a noble gas and neither apologises.

factCards.text: Krypton is element 36; from 1960 to 1983 the metre was defined by a wavelength of light emitted by krypton-86.
factCards.sourceTitle: BIPM — The International System of Units (SI Brochure), historical definitions of the metre

factCards.text: The quasar 3C 273 was identified in 1963 by Maarten Schmidt, who recognised its unusual spectrum as a large redshift.
factCards.sourceTitle: Nature 197, 1040 (1963) — M. Schmidt, '3C 273: A Star-Like Object with Large Red-Shift'

factCards.text: Enya's 'Orinoco Flow' was released in 1988 and takes its name from the river as well as from Orinoco Studios in London.
factCards.sourceTitle: Official Charts Company — Enya chart history
